1445-4871-8095-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-8095-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

401-3944-6794-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-6794-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

643-2292-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2292-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-4288-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-4288-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-967-3809-7087-7824.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

5256-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
5256-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-6791-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

2302-2773-3490-4050-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2302-2773-3490-4050-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

7-562-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-562-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4050-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-5870.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-4907-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1445-5477-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-6968.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1336-1978-2750.description:
Cause Heronblade Elite to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2267-5497-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2267-5497-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

654-678-2292-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4002-4875.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3767-3918-4002-4875.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

955-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
955-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

877-1374-2350-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

146-1148-5955.description:
Cast Slaughter Pact, choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, by paying a total of {0}, targeting Giggling Skitterspike.
Giggling Skitterspike and Slaughter Pact's replicate ability trigger.
Resolve the Giggling Skitterspike trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.
Resolve the Slaughter Pact trigger, copying it for each time its replicate cost was paid, with each copy targeting Giggling Skitterspike.
Giggling Skitterspike triggers for each Slaughter Pact copy made.
Resolve a Giggling Skitterspike trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
146-1148-5955.notes: This combo will result in you losing the game during your next upkeep step, due to all the delayed triggers from Slaughter Pact and the Slaughter Pact copies. It is highly recommended to only use this combo if you have high certainty it will end the game.

1414-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1414-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

401-3652-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-3652-4050.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {1}.
When Ornithopter dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1912-2034-2703-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2034-2703-2816.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-4424-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
2034-4424-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle and Missy's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Missy trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cyberman, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cyberman dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face up, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3632.description:
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, triggering its first ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

2228-2850-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Repeat.

775-1563-4231-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Jewel Thief.
Jewel Thief enters the battlefield, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
